stem.en: In six States, the legislature has two houses. Which of these is NOT a way to become a member of the Vidhan Parishad?

text.en: Being elected by members of the Vidhan Sabha and local bodies.
Being elected by graduates and teachers in the State.
Being chosen by all voters of the State, as for the Vidhan Sabha.
Being nominated by the Governor from fields such as art and science.

explanation.en: Vidhan Parishad members are elected by members of the Vidhan Sabha and local bodies, and by graduates and teachers, and some are nominated by the Governor. All the voters of a State do not elect this house directly.

hints.en: The question asks for the one that is NOT a route.
Which house do all the voters elect directly?
